core_obligations: Given sigma in D_q, lift it to tau in H by the surjectivity of Gal(M/K) -> Gal(L/K) (proof lines 32889-32890). Then tau(r) and r both lie over q, so by the one-orbit lemma there is sigma' in Gal(M/L) with sigma'(tau(r)) = r; the composition sigma' tau fixes r, hence lies in D_r, and maps to sigma under H -> G (proof lines 32891-32895). For inertia groups the same argument applies with the induced maps on residue fields: one uses the surjectivity onto the automorphism groups of the residue field extensions to arrange that the lift acts trivially modulo r (proof lines 32896-32897).
proof_roadmap: Lift sigma to tau in H and align tau(r) with r via the one-orbit lemma (proof lines 32889-32895).
Handle inertia groups by the same argument with automorphism groups of residue fields (proof lines 32896-32897).
